title: ASSOCIATE TEACHER LEVEL I
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: ASSOCIATE TEACHER LEVEL I - Saddleback - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Identify developmental milestones for children in the areas of physical, psychosocial, cognitive, and language development.
Identify environmental, cultural, familial, economic, political, and historical contexts that influence all children's development.
Identify a range of introductory skills and knowledge related to the unique need of children ages 0-8 years.
Describe developmentally appropriate teaching practices for children ages 0-8.
careers: entry level positions in a variety of early childhood care and education settings

missing_explained.why: not in the requirements; renumbered as CDEV C1000 (course description says 'Formerly offered as CDE 7')

notes: CDEV C1000 (Child Growth and Development) replaces closed-list CDE 7 per its course description; recorded as a catalog addition.

Career entry taken from the summary phrase 'prepares students for entry level positions in a variety of early childhood care and education settings'; reviewer may judge whether it counts as a career field.
Certificate also requires a minimum grade of C in each course; additional work experience (50 days of 3+ hours) is required for the Associate Teacher Permit but not for the certificate.
